name: send-koro
description: Send Koro — NYC food delivery marketplace (core API + payments service, NestJS, Drizzle, Postgres, Stripe Connect)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix services/payments install && npm --prefix services/api install && npm --prefix apps/customer-web install && npm --prefix apps/restaurant-web install && npm --prefix apps/admin-web install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix services/payments run db:migrate && npm --prefix services/api run db:migrate
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/payments test && npm --prefix services/api test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/payments run typecheck && npm --prefix services/api run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix services/payments run build && npm --prefix services/api run build
